title: 4521-MOM-LOI-039-062-0001-GAR Rev02 Performnace Test Procedure
summary:
- The document describes performance testing procedures for Oil to Salt heat exchangers.
- It outlines the thermal balance, pressure drop, HAT, CAT values, and OHTC calculations.
- ASME PTC 12.5-2000 and MS-HTF HEX Warranty Annex COMMENTED are referenced.
- Correction factors simulate equipment behavior under real conditions.
- Stakeholders must agree on testing responsibilities and reference conditions.
- Four variables are measured for thermal calculation of the system.
- ASME PTC 12.5 is used to determine the accuracy of calculations.
- Client and Lointek decide on the most reliable measurements.
- Heat exchanger must operate at steady state conditions before testing.
- Two measurements ensure repeatability of results.
- Fouling coefficient can be reviewed based on direct observation.
- Sizing of heat exchangers depends on process conditions in the nominal design case.
summary_points: The document describes performance testing procedures for Oil to Salt heat exchangers.
It outlines the thermal balance, pressure drop, HAT, CAT values, and OHTC calculations.
ASME PTC 12.5-2000 and MS-HTF HEX Warranty Annex COMMENTED are referenced.
Correction factors simulate equipment behavior under real conditions.
Stakeholders must agree on testing responsibilities and reference conditions.
Four variables are measured for thermal calculation of the system.
ASME PTC 12.5 is used to determine the accuracy of calculations.
Client and Lointek decide on the most reliable measurements.
Heat exchanger must operate at steady state conditions before testing.
Two measurements ensure repeatability of results.
Fouling coefficient can be reviewed based on direct observation.
Sizing of heat exchangers depends on process conditions in the nominal design case.
Effect of fouling resistance is considered in HTRI calculation program.
Instruments installed during assembly are used to calculate the performance of the exchanger.
Accuracy requirements include Flow ± 5%, Temperature ± 3.69 ºF, Pressure ± 0.3 %.
Include a plane of the tubesheet in Annex A for plugged tubes.
Review overall dimensions, lagging placement, number of plugged tubes, cleaning of surfaces, and instrument placement before final performance test.
Install thermometers, manometers, and mass flow meters at inlet and outlet of hot and cold fluids.
Perform measures during steady state conditions for at least 15 minutes with 15 measures every 2 minutes for 30 minutes.
